תנא (12b.17): all the names are given for Mordechai
the family of Judah, as the Rabbis put it (12b.19)
the family of Benjamin, as the Rabbis put it (12b.19)
the Congregation of Israel, in Rava's account (12b.20-13a.1)

props.gloss_en: the verse: 'there was a Jewish man in Shushan the capital... son of Yair son of Shimi son of Kish, a Benjaminite' (Esth 2:5) -- object of the stam's two difficulties
a tanna: all of them [the names in his lineage] are names given for him [Mordechai]
'son of Yair' -- who lit up Israel's eyes with his prayer; 'son of Shimi' -- whose prayer God heard; 'son of Kish' -- who knocked on the gates of mercy and they opened for him
Rav Nachman: Mordechai was crowned with his title [Yehudi as a title of honour]
Rabba bar bar Chana in the name of R' Yehoshua ben Levi: his father was from Benjamin and his mother from Judah
the Rabbis: the families contend with each other [over him]
the family of Judah says: I caused Mordechai to be born, for David did not kill Shimi son of Gera
and the family of Benjamin said: he comes from me
Rava: the Congregation of Israel said it the other way: see what a Judean did to me and what a Benjaminite repaid me
[Congregation of Israel:] that David did not kill Shimi, from whom was born Mordechai against whom Haman was jealous; and that Saul did not kill Agag, from whom was born Haman who afflicted Israel
R' Yochanan: he actually came from Benjamin; why is he called Yehudi? because he repudiated idolatry
for whoever repudiates idolatry is called Yehudi, as written: 'there are Jewish men...' (Dan 3:12)
the verse: 'there are certain Jewish men... they do not serve your gods' (Dan 3:12)
R' Shimon ben Pazi, when he opened [expounding] Chronicles, said: all Your words are one, and we know how to expound them
the verse: 'and his wife the Judean bore Yered father of Gedor... and these are the sons of Bitya daughter of Pharaoh whom Mered took' (1 Chr 4:18)
why is she called 'the Judean'? because she repudiated idolatry, as written 'and Pharaoh's daughter went down to bathe at the river' (Ex 2:5)
and R' Yochanan said: she went down to wash herself of her father's house's idols
to tell you that whoever raises an orphan boy or girl in his home, Scripture considers it as if he bore him
Yered is Moses; why is he called Yered? for manna came down (yarad) for Israel in his days

Gedor -- he fenced Israel's breaches; Chever -- joined Israel to their Father in heaven; Socho -- became a shelter (sukka) for Israel; Yekutiel -- Israel hoped (kivu) to God in his days; Zanoach -- he set aside (hizniach) Israel's sins
'father... father... father' -- a father in Torah, a father in wisdom, a father in prophecy
the verse: 'and these are the sons of Bitya whom Mered took' -- object of the difficulty וכי מרד שמו
the Holy One said: let Calev, who rebelled against the spies' plot, come and marry Pharaoh's daughter, who rebelled against her father's idols
'who had been exiled from Jerusalem' (Esth 2:6): Rava -- he went into exile of his own accord
